prompt:
You are a infrastructure fix agent. There are TWO problems to solve:

  ## Problem
  The home machine can't read orchestrator prompts from this (work) machine. prompt-hook.js writes to agent-hub/prompts/
  locally, but the agent-hub repos on each machine are separate git clones at different paths. Prompts never sync.

  ## Systemic Fix
  
First, check where prompt-hook.js writes prompts on this machine — read hooks/prompt-hook.js and find PROMPTS_DIR
Check where the agent-hub git repo is on this machine (likely ~/Claude/projects/agent-mission-control/)
Verify prompts/ is inside the git-tracked repo (not gitignored)
If prompts/ IS tracked: just commit and push all .ndjson files in prompts/
If prompts/ is NOT tracked or is gitignored: remove the gitignore entry, add it, commit, push
After pushing, verify: git log --oneline -1 shows the commit

  ## Verify
  Run: git status in the agent-hub repo. There should be no untracked .ndjson files in prompts/. All prompts should be
  committed and pushed so the home machine can git pull and read them.

  The goal: every prompt captured on ANY machine is automatically available on every other machine after a git pull. No
  manual copying ever again.
